title: The neutrino behavior in the Einstein$\text{-}$Hilbert$\text{-}$Bumblebee gravity around global monopole field
summary: In this work, we study the neutrino oscillation phase propagating along radial and non-radial paths in the Einstein$\text{-}$Hilbert$\text{-}$Bumblebee (EHB) gravity around global monopole field, by using the quantummechanical treatment, the expression of the corrected neutrino oscillation probability is obtained.
